electricityContract.terms: This offer is available to customers with a flat-rate network tariff. If your network tariff is amended by your distributor, we will notify you of options available. Full terms & conditions and solar feed in tariff eligibility available on our website. Ongoing discounts of 2% to daily supply and consumption charges for each customer/property you refer for period referee stays with us. Discounts are additive. Pay on Time conditions apply. Your friend also receives $35 (incl. GST) sign up credit.
electricityContract.variation: We may vary the Charges (including their amount, structure), discounts, solar feed either annually in July or as per applicable regulatory requirements. We will give you written notice of any variations to rates, charges and feed-in at least 5 business days prior to the variation in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

greenPowerCharges.description: For 0.55 c / kWh inc. GST we ensure energy equal to 50% of your consumption will be fed into the grid from Accredited GreenPower generators
For 1.1c / kWh inc. GST we ensure energy equal to 100% of your consumption will be fed into the grid from Accredited GreenPower generators

solarFeedInTariff.description: Diamond Energy Standard Feed-in Rate, subject to eligibility. Amounts are GST exclusive (if any)

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription: This is an ongoing agreement with ongoing benefits and continues until you or we end it.
electricityContract.additionalFeeInformation: You may be charged fees from your electricity distributor in relation to services performed at your supply address, including special meter reads, connection and disconnection services. These fees are passed through to you and may vary. For further details, visit https://diamondenergy.com.au/service-fees-and-charges/.
